candidate_rule: Each complete-update model+Adam checkpoint and its same-update 64-seed evaluation require an exact parent audit receipt before selection.

evaluation.cohort: same 64 D2 deterministic argmax development seeds
secondary: Q1 bottom-16 mean alive raw frames
Q4 top-16 mean alive raw frames
evaluation.objective_return: score delta + 0.01 * alive raw frames - 5 * death

selection: Replace current BEST180 only with a strictly higher primary mean from a completed candidate whose exact checkpoint and evaluation passed parent audit. Otherwise retain BEST180.
